rv.q: The format of three short stories, threaded together with a catchy jingle by Duramaney Karama, is rather harder to get a grip on than an overarching narrative with momentum.
Theatre and Air Theatre have created a fantastic family spin on the arachnid trickster.

cn.t: This family-friendly adaptation of the West African trickster tale earns praise for bringing the oral storytelling tradition to life, with critics finding it well-suited for younger primary school audiences in its outdoor setting.
